claims_boundary: This record treats the August 26, 2026 QSB transaction as a consensus-compatible Bitcoin mainnet proof-of-concept. It does not claim Bitcoin is quantum-safe, does not claim standard relay support, and does not claim protection for already-exposed public keys or a network-wide migration path.
limitations: The construction uses nonstandard transaction formats and did not rely on ordinary mempool relay for the demonstrated transaction.
It is relevant to coins whose public keys remain hidden before migration; it does not rescue keys already exposed long enough for a future adversary to recover.
A successful mainnet proof does not supply production wallet integration, network-wide migration, legacy rescue, or signature-sunset policy.
A protocol-level PQ authorization/output path remains strategically preferable for scalable deployment and recovery policy.
